title: feat: collapse non-essential header controls into an overflow menu on narrow widths
description: At ≤480px the header consumes 4 rows (filter, sort+group, show-closed+copy-URL, +new-task+?) — taking ~30% of vertical space before any task content shows. Suggested fix: at narrow widths, keep filter + new-task visible and tuck sort/group/show-closed/copy-URL/? into a kebab menu. See tmp/responsive/{320,375,414,480}.png.
